payload.core_mechanism_summary: Counts skills by remainder mod 10, then greedily adds improvements to cheapest remainder to gain rating points, processing remainders in increasing cost order (1 to 9). Finally, uses remaining improvements in full tens.
payload.rationale: The solution implicitly sorts skills by the cost to reach the next multiple of 10 (using frequency buckets instead of explicit sorting), which aligns with sorting_custom_key: sort by cost = 10 - (a%10). The greedy allocation is typical for this subtype.
